claim: Finding: property management figures (78% of screened fee managers use some AI, 7% agentic, 'Only 9% have measured any quantifiable improvement in business performance as a result of AI', 751 professionals + 554 owners/investors)
problem: The finding's only cited URL is the Big 'I' press release, which contains none of the property-management numbers. The numbers are accurate but the citation does not carry them, and the quoted fragment 'agentic AI ... to complete a multistep task' splices non-contiguous words (source reads 'Agentic AI, in which AI completes a multistep task from start to finish under human supervision').
fix: Add https://www.appfolio.com/blog/narpm-ai-property-management-report-2026 as the second source_url for this finding and quote the agentic-AI sentence contiguously; keep the existing caveat that 78% is a screened, AI-using sample.

claim: Finding: Ahrefs analysed 137,210 domains, found '97% of those files received zero traffic in May 2026' and 'no major AI platform has ever committed to reading it'
problem: Both quotes and the 137,210 sample are correct, but they are not on the cited page (llmstxt.studio/stats); no Ahrefs URL is given anywhere in the brief.
fix: Cite https://ahrefs.com/blog/llmstxt-study/ alongside the registry, or move the Ahrefs sentence into the caveats with its own URL.

claim: Finding: 'The earlier (21 Aug 2025) post describes the same flow: AI Mode "links you directly to the booking page, so you can easily take the last step and finalize your reservation."'
problem: Quote verified verbatim, but the only source_url on the finding is the 17 Nov 2025 post, which does not contain it.
fix: Add https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/search/ai-mode-agentic-personalized/ as a second URL for the finding.

claim: Finding: 'Cyclr's comparison of 816 SaaS products found verified official MCP support rose from 47 products (5.8%) in 2025 to 100 (12.3%) in 2026'
problem: Figures check out (47 -> 100 of the same 816, 5.8% -> 12.3%, research cutoff Aug 2026) but no URL is cited and the cited page (theoryvc.com) does not contain them; the '2025'/'2026' labels are the brief's framing of a single 2025-2026 comparison.
fix: Cite https://cyclr.com/resources/reports/the-state-of-mcp-2025-2026 and describe it as one comparison run in 2026 against 2025 baseline, not as two annual editions.

claim: Finding: Apple Business 'place cards now surface in Maps, Safari, Spotlight and Siri'
problem: The release lists place cards as displaying 'across Apple Maps, Safari, Spotlight, and more'; Siri appears in the separate sentence about connecting with local customers, not in the place-card bullet.
fix: Write 'Maps, Safari and Spotlight (Apple also cites Siri among the surfaces it reaches)'.

claim: Summary and Recommendation 2/6: 'Google and Apple each let a business attach a booking or reserve action that customers and agents can follow' / 'a booking/reserve link on Google Business Profile and Apple Business'
problem: The Apple half is documented (Flexible Action Links). The Google half is not: the cited Google pages describe Google booking through partners or calling the business, not the owner attaching a reserve link to the profile. Presented as documented fact rather than inference.
fix: Either label the Google half as inference from the partner-booking flow, or drop the Google 'attach a link' clause and keep 'listed with a booking partner'.

claim: Resource: Google Search Console 'Generative AI performance report' for AI Overviews/AI Mode visibility
problem: Report exists (support.google.com/webmasters/answer/16984139, linked from the optimization guide) but the resource cites the optimization guide, which only links out to it and does not describe the report's contents.
fix: Point the resource at https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/16984139 and keep the guide as the secondary reference.

claim: Recommendation 5: 'the missed-call and no-show studies we found are vendor-produced or single-practice'
problem: Only the vendor missed-call study appears anywhere in the brief; no no-show study is listed in findings, data_gaps or pitfalls, so the reference is dangling.
fix: Remove 'and no-show' or add the no-show source to data_gaps with why it was excluded.
